value.body: A food safety executive keeps a food business's safety and hygiene systems running and audit-ready. Food manufacturers, restaurant and cloud-kitchen chains, caterers, retailers and warehouses hire them. A day involves floor checks, reviewing records, training staff on hygiene and following up on issues found in audits.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech / B.Sc Food Technology or Microbiology

items.label: Systems you work with
items.value: HACCP, FSSAI licensing rules, FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join as QA or food safety trainees or executives at food plants and food-service chains, through campus placement or direct application. Short certifications such as HACCP or FSSAI's FoSTaC training are commonly asked for.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Training staff on safe food handling

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: QA manager, food safety auditor, regulatory specialist.
The role is documentation-heavy and audit-driven.
This is a private-sector role; government Food Safety Officer posts are a separate recruitment.
